content.short: OBS World is a metaverse for petrolheads with virtual racing and a vibrant community.
content.description: OBS World unlocks a shared metaverse for petrolheads, bringing racers together beyond borders through high-speed competition and a thriving digital community. Players can explore immersive environments, interact with others, and dive into car-themed games. The OBS Community can keep up with motorsport news, access a range of content and entertainment, and participate in activities such as auctioneering, digital retail, sports betting, or creating and trading graphic assets.
